translations.web: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?
translations.bsb: What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
translations.kjv: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
translations.asv: What man is he that shall live and not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
